abstract: A total of 33 specimens from 29 patients with residual stable teratoma and mature growing teratoma after chemotherapy was analyzed for clinicopathological and deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) flow cytometric variables, as well as the presence of proliferative antigen and tumor marker levels in an attempt to explain their clinical behavior. We compared the flow cytometric and histological data of these stable and growing teratomas, and of nonseminomatous germ cell tumors before chemotherapy. The DNA content of residual teratoma did not differ significantly from that of the primary testicular tumors (1.38 versus 1.48). Histological analysis of stable and growing teratomas revealed no significant difference but proliferative cellular nuclear antigen was expressed mainly in the epithelial component of the growing teratoma. alpha-Fetoprotein, beta-human chorionic gonadotropin and carcinoembryonic antigen were elevated in the fluid of 6 excised teratomas, while concomitant serum levels were normal. The aneuploidy and elevated cystic fluid tumor markers confirm the malignant phenotype of post-chemotherapy residual teratomas. Therefore, complete surgical removal is essential despite the benign histological appearance.
abstract_ja: 化学療法後の残存安定奇形腫および増大する成熟奇形腫の計29例33検体について、臨床病理学的指標およびデオキシリボ核酸(DNA)フローサイトメトリー解析、増殖性細胞核抗原の発現、腫瘍マーカー値を解析した。奇形腫のDNA量は原発精巣腫瘍との間に有意差はなかった(1.38対1.48)。安定奇形腫と増大奇形腫の組織学的解析に有意差はみられなかったが、増殖性細胞核抗原は増大奇形腫の上皮成分に主に発現していた。切除された奇形腫6例では、嚢胞液中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(β-hCG)、癌胎児性抗原(CEA)が上昇していたが、同時期の血清値は正常であった。異数性と嚢胞液中腫瘍マーカーの上昇は、化学療法後に残存する奇形腫の悪性形質を裏付けるものである。したがって、組織像が良性にみえても完全な外科的切除が不可欠である。
